checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Final video is 10 seconds long and landscape 16:9
must.why: The final MP4 was not provided. The agent claims 854×480, 10 s. The audio file is 15 s, which doesn't match, though it may have been trimmed.

must.item: Home screenshot appears before workout screenshot
must.why: The prepared frames are in order: home (image 3), then workout (image 4). The agent's timeline matches.

must.item: Both screenshots recognizable and readable, no invented UI
must.why: All labels and numbers match the originals. There is slight noise and blur in the blue header and a faint shadow on the boxes, but no invented UI.
The end card frame was not provided. It is only claimed in the agent's description.
The audio has sound at a -1 dB peak, but the mood and the lack of voiceover can't be judged. The file is 15 s, not 10 s.

exact_text.read_as: FitTrack (visible in the home screenshot header; the end card was not shown)

faults.what: The portrait screenshots are placed on a 854×480 landscape canvas, so they are small, with big white side areas. Text will be small and hard to read at 480p.
The agent said the screenshots were 'unchanged', but the prepared versions show slight noise, blur and added shadows.
The two main segments are static stills, so the ad is not very energetic. The end card could not be verified.
The audio file is 15 s against a 10 s video. It may be trimmed in the final mix.

summary: The home and workout screenshots are faithfully preserved and in the right order, but the final video and end card could not be checked, the ad is two static stills in small portrait frames, and the audio is 15 s rather than 10 s.
